## Full About
Superior Home Builders is a licensed and insured general contractor based in Mount Vernon, Oregon, serving Grant County and Eastern Oregon since 2004. The company builds custom homes from site preparation through finish work, with particular depth in off-grid home construction on rural land — coordinating wells, septic systems, solar power, and access roads alongside the build itself. Beyond new construction, Superior Home Builders handles kitchen and bathroom remodels, whole-house renovations, structural framing, custom decks, window and door replacement, and commercial construction for local businesses. Every project begins with a free on-site estimate and a written, itemized proposal, and all required permits are pulled by the company.

## Service Details

### Custom Home Building
Full custom home construction tailored to the client's vision and budget, from design and permitting through site preparation, framing, and finishing. Includes off-grid builds on raw rural land. Typical timeframe: 6–14 months depending on size and complexity.

### General Remodeling
Comprehensive remodeling for any room or area of the home, from single-room updates to whole-house renovations, handled from planning to final touches.

### Kitchen Remodeling
Kitchen renovation with custom cabinetry, countertops, and modern appliances. Typical cost range in Eastern Oregon: $12,000–$20,000 for a cosmetic refresh up to $35,000–$75,000+ for a full gut-and-rebuild. Typical timeframe: 3–6 weeks.

### Bathroom Remodeling
Custom bathroom renovation including tile work, fixtures, and plumbing upgrades. Typical cost range: $8,000–$12,000 for a basic update to $18,000–$35,000+ for a full renovation. Typical timeframe: 2–4 weeks.

### Windows and Doors
Replacement window and exterior door installation in existing homes, using energy-efficient vinyl, fiberglass, and wood products.

### Decks
Ground-level, elevated, and multi-level decks in pressure-treated lumber, composite, or cedar, designed and built to current Oregon building code.

### Framing
Residential and commercial structural framing for new construction and remodeling projects.

### Commercial Construction
Commercial construction and renovation for businesses throughout Grant County and Eastern Oregon, including office build-outs and light commercial projects.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is Superior Home Builders licensed and insured in Oregon?
A: Yes. Superior Home Builders is a fully licensed Oregon Construction Contractors Board (CCB) contractor and carries general liability insurance, qualified for both residential and commercial work.

Q: What areas does Superior Home Builders serve?
A: Based in Mount Vernon, OR, primarily serving Grant County — including John Day, Canyon City, and Prairie City — plus projects in other parts of Eastern Oregon and select projects in the Salem area.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes — free, no-obligation estimates on all projects, starting with an on-site visit and a written, itemized estimate.

Q: What services do you offer?
A: Eight core services: Bathroom Remodeling, Kitchen Remodeling, Windows & Doors, Deck Building, Structural Framing, Custom Home Building, General Remodeling, and Commercial Construction.

Q: Can you build a custom home from scratch in Mount Vernon, OR?
A: Yes. Custom home building is a flagship service — covering planning, permitting, site preparation, framing, and finish work.

Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Mount Vernon, OR?
A: Typically $8,000–$12,000 for a basic update to $18,000–$35,000+ for a full renovation with tile, new fixtures, and plumbing changes.

Q: What does kitchen remodeling cost?
A: From $12,000–$20,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $35,000–$75,000+ for a full gut-and-rebuild with custom cabinetry and new appliances.

Q: How long will my project take?
A: A bathroom remodel typically takes 2–4 weeks; a kitchen remodel 3–6 weeks; a custom home build 6–14 months depending on size and complexity.

Q: Do you pull permits for construction and remodeling work?
A: Yes. Superior Home Builders pulls all required permits for work in Grant County and complies with Oregon building code throughout.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Fill out the contact form at https://superiorhomebuilderscorp.com/contact/ and describe your project — a free on-site estimate will be scheduled.
